findings.reason: without a sentence saying `section_readiness` is produced from the verdict (or removed in its favour), an implementer satisfies the paragraph verbatim and leaves the served roadmap reporting a gate-held section ready while the queue holds it, which is the two-answers-one-fact disagreement §8 exists to remove.
findings.text: §8 says "The roadmap's own section rows and the queue both read it [the new public per-section verdict]", while the same paragraph's assembly sentence keeps returning rows "with their per-section `section_readiness`" — the conditionally-attached, gate-blind list that `docs/ui/sprint.jsx:173` renders and, when absent, treats as `ready: true`. The change therefore leaves the roadmap row carrying two different per-section answers: the field the plan has just shown omits section-scoped gate holds (reckon/roadmap.py:3598-3611 populates it from dependency and decision blockers only), and the verdict it adds. A gate-held section in the "gate names that section and leaves another implementable section unnamed" shape satisfies `is_ready` (reckon/roadmap.py:3438-3448, reproduced: `plan_holding=[] section_gate_blockers=['g1']`) and so stays `ready: true` in `section_readiness`, exactly the reading the new verdict is introduced to correct.

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `ready_sections_by_plan` (reckon/roadmap.py:2796, :3633), `ready_sections` (:3606), `_readiness_rows` (reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:1056), `_readiness_by_slug` (reckon/crew/plan_review.py:3094), `run_path` (reckon/ledger.py:890), `parse_plan_ref` (reckon/_schema.py:276), `TaskNode` (reckon/crew/node.py:725), `sweep_promoted_revisions` with its `target_head="HEAD"` default (reckon/crew/promotion.py:1985) and `reckon/roadmap.py` as a write path all resolve.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — the changed unit's mechanism now produces both gate shapes its done-when asserts: `split_unpassed_gates` returns `plan_holding=[]` with `section_gate_blockers=['g1']` when a gate names one implementable section and leaves another unnamed, and `plan_holding=['g1']` with an empty section list when it names every implementable section, so "takes the plan's place in the ready set, then applies … its section gate holds" answers both arms.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the changed unit names no gate log or evidence path; its write paths are repository modules plus a new test file.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the changed text introduces no plan label, stage name, ticket number or version tag into a symbol, file or comment.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — the paragraph correctly diagnoses that no single roadmap output answers a section's readiness today, but it adds a second per-section answer without saying the row's existing one is rebuilt from it.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — the changed paragraph serves §8's one deliverable, a queue that reads the work's cross-plan DAG readiness, and adds no second deliverable.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — s8 declares `plan-section-depends-on` on s2, and s9 and s15 declare s8 in the plan's relationship map, so the node that consumes the per-section verdict is wired to it.
